note: Hard facts the forge relies on. 'tier' uses the evidence ladder: tool-validated = checked by running code against an installed game; source = read from upstream source code; docs = upstream docs/wiki; observed = seen in an installed mod or log, not documented. Re-check anything marked docs or observed when a framework updates.

game.versions.detail: Key is the four-part file version of bin/x64/Cyberpunk2077.exe. Windows Explorer shows 3.0.88.46235 as '3.0.5813403' (build << 16 | revision). tool-validated: an installed 2.5 exe reports 3.0.88.46235.

value.r6/scripts/<Mod>/: redscript (.reds), compiled at game start by redscript
value.archive/pc/mod/: packed .archive files plus ArchiveXL .archive.xl next to them
value.bin/x64/plugins/cyber_engine_tweaks/mods: CET Lua mod; init.lua is the entry point
value.red4ext/plugins/<Mod>/: RED4ext native plugin DLL (plus optional .reds the plugin ships)
value.mods/<Mod>/: REDmod: info.json plus archives/, scripts/, tweaks/, customSounds/

value.header: u32 magic 0x52414452 'RDAR', u32 version (12), u64 indexPosition, u32 indexSize, u64 debugPosition, u32 debugSize, u64 fileSize, u32 customDataLength
value.index: at indexPosition: u32 fileTableOffset, u32 fileTableSize, u64 crc, u32 fileEntryCount, u32 fileSegmentCount, u32 resourceDependencyCount
value.file_entry: 56 bytes: u64 nameHash (FNV-1a 64 of the resource path), i64 timestamp (FILETIME), u32 inlineBufferSegments, u32 segmentsStart, u32 segmentsEnd, u32 dependenciesStart, u32 dependenciesEnd, 20 bytes SHA1
value.segment: 16 bytes: u64 offset, u32 zsize, u32 size
value.path_hash: FNV-1a 64 (offset 0xCBF29CE484222325, prime 0x100000001B3) over the lowercase path with backslash separators

archive.format.detail: Checked against an installed 2.5 game: basegame_4_gamedata.archive indexSize equals 28 + 56*entries + 16*segments + 8*deps exactly; 39 of 39 factory .csv paths from installed .archive.xl files hashed to entries of their archives.

tweakdb.id.value: low 32 bits: standard CRC-32 (zlib) of the UTF-8 name; bits 32-39: byte length; bytes 5-7: tdbOffset (big-endian, ignored for equality)
tweakdb.id.detail: Checked: Character.Judy, Items.Preset_Lexington_Default and Vehicle.v_sport2_quadra_type66_player found in r6/cache/tweakdb.bin.

value.header: u32 magic 0x0BB1DB47, i32 blobVersion (8), i32 parserVersion (4), u32 recordsChecksum, i32 flatsOffset, i32 recordsOffset, i32 queriesOffset, i32 groupTagsOffset
value.records: at recordsOffset: i32 count, then count x (u64 TweakDBID, u32 typeKey)
value.type_key: Murmur3-32, seed 0x5EEDBA5E, of the bare type name (Character for gamedataCharacter_Record)

tweakdb.bin.detail: Checked: 196423 records in the 2.5 tweakdb.bin; typeKey of Character.Judy = murmur3('Character'), of a vehicle = murmur3('Vehicle').

tweakdb.str.source: observed in r6/cache/modded/tweakdb_ep1.str (written when REDmod deploys)
tweakdb.str.value: u32 magic 0x0BB1DB57, u32 version 1, u32 recordNameCount, u32 flatNameCount, u32 queryNameCount, then names as RED strings: first byte bit 7 = ASCII flag, bit 6 = more length bytes follow, low 6 bits = length
tweakdb.str.detail: Gives the full list of record and flat names; only present after a REDmod deploy.

value.tools/redmod/scripts/**/*.script: vanilla game script source (CDPR script syntax: 'function', 'var x : T', 'importonly class')
value.tools/redmod/metadata.json: native RTTI dump: classes (parent, properties, functions), enums, global_functions, bitfields, aliases

redmod.sources.detail: Installed by the free REDmod DLC. The forge indexes them locally; they are never copied into a project or this repository.

redscript.continue.value: 'continue' in loops is supported from redscript 1.0.0. The 0.5.x compilers reject it (observed: UNRESOLVED_REF with 0.5.31).
redscript.continue.detail: Write loops without 'continue' when the mod must work on 0.5.x.

redscript.annotations.detail: Two mods using @replaceMethod on the same Class.method conflict: only one replacement survives. @wrapMethod stacks.

redscript.scc_cli.value: scc.exe -compile <scriptsDir> -compilePathsFile <file listing extra .reds dirs> -outputCacheFile <out>. The base bundle is read from cache/final.redscripts next to the scripts directory (r6/scripts -> r6/cache), so a scratch compile uses <tmp>/scripts and <tmp>/cache.
redscript.scc_cli.detail: The standalone compiler can overflow its stack on a full load order of several hundred mods (the in-game compile does not). Compile a mod with only its dependencies.

redscript.logging.source: cpforge compile against the 2.5 vanilla bundle
redscript.logging.value: FTLog(s"...") compiles with no extra mod. LogChannel(n"DEBUG", ...) is native-only in vanilla and fails with UNRESOLVED_FN unless a mod declares it (e.g. a logging-headers library); Codeware provides ModLog(n"Mod", ...).
redscript.logging.detail: Native functions listed in tools/redmod/metadata.json are not callable from redscript until something declares them.

cet.layout.value: bin/x64/plugins/cyber_engine_tweaks/mods/<Mod>/init.lua; a mod reads and writes only inside its own folder
cet.layout.detail: Events: onInit, onUpdate, onDraw, onOverlayOpen, onOverlayClose, onShutdown, onTweak.

tweak.source_syntax.source: cpforge tweaksrc parser run over a 2.5 install

archivexl.xl.value: <name>.archive.xl next to <name>.archive. Documented keys include factories (list of .csv paths in the archive) and localization.onscreens (language -> .json path).

value.exports: bool Main(RED4ext::v1::PluginHandle, RED4ext::v1::EMainReason, const RED4ext::v1::Sdk*); void Query(RED4ext::v1::PluginInfo*); uint32_t Supports()
value.macros: RED4EXT_C_EXPORT, RED4EXT_CALL, RED4EXT_V1_SEMVER, RED4EXT_V1_RUNTIME_VERSION_LATEST, RED4EXT_V1_SDK_VERSION_CURRENT, RED4EXT_API_VERSION_1
value.cmake: FetchContent RED4ext.SDK, link RED4ext::SDK, C++20, x64
value.runtime_note: SDK tag 1.0.0 defines LATEST as 2.31; 2.5 support landed in commit 0f5eba4 (2026-10-22). A plugin declaring runtime 2.31 is refused by RED4ext on a 2.5 game.

redmod.info_json.value: mods/<Mod>/info.json with name and version (required), description, customSounds (array, used by audio mods)

input_loader.xml.value: r6/input/*.xml with a <bindings> root holding <context name=...> (append="true" to extend an existing context) with <action name=... map=...> and <include name=...>

mod_settings.value: @runtimeProperty("ModSettings.mod", "Mod name") and ModSettings.displayName/description/category/min/max/step on public fields of a class; register with ModSettings.RegisterListenerToClass(this)
mod_settings.detail: category, step, min and max are used by many installed mods (observed); the README documents mod, displayName and displayValues.

audioware.manifest.value: r6/audioware/<Mod>/<name>.yaml: 'version: 1.0.0' then 'sfx:' mapping an event name to {file: <audio file next to the yaml>, settings: {volume: 1.0}}
